source_change: Explicit diagnostic only; application models/queries unchanged
hypothesis: Count/page search spends CPU joining listing/state/revision twice. A compact temporary projection may reduce that cost; measure before designing persistent maintenance.
limitations: Static syntheticcopy no mutations; no freshness/invalidation/maintenance/filtergeneral/outofrange proof; no model/schema product change or HTTPload
decision_rule: If material benefit demonstrated, investigate exact existing trigger/refresher maintenance and narrow activation before any product candidate. Never accept static projection as live readiness.
